name: WaveRange Compression
aliases: WaveRange Compression for Global Weather Simulations
definition: A data compression workflow for 3D atmospheric simulation restart files that concatenates decomposed sub-domains into a single 3D array per field before applying wavelet transform and range coding to maximize compression ratio.
summary: WaveRange Compression maximizes compression for 3D atmospheric data by concatenating sub-domains into a single array before wavelet transform, leveraging global statistics for higher ratios than independent processing.
